name: Raleigh Andrean
summary: Raleigh Andrean is a Forsaken resident of the Undercity. His requests reveal a callous attitude toward his former human life and those he once knew.

sections.title: A Bitter Afterlife
sections.body: Before the Third War devastated Lordaeron, Raleigh Andrean lived an ordinary human life, married to a woman named Deliah and keeping company with his friend Valdred Moray. Like countless others, he fell when the Scourge tore through the kingdom, only to be raised as a mindless thrall in service to the Lich King. He regained his free will following the shattering of the Ner'zhul's grip and Sylvanas Windrunner's uprising, taking his place among the Forsaken in the Undercity.

sections.title: Vengeance over Grief
sections.body: When presented with his late wife's wedding ring, Raleigh displays the callous emotional decay of undeath. He harbors no sorrow or lingering love for Deliah, coldly dismissing her death. Instead, his focus fixates entirely on spite: he demands the severed hands of Valdred Moray, his former friend who murdered her. Raleigh keeps the gruesome trophies not out of affection for Deliah, but as an eternal memento of betrayal, rewarding whoever aids him with a ring forged of pure scorn.

faq.answer: Raleigh Andrean resides within the bustling Trade Quarter of the Undercity, standing among the subterranean city's Forsaken populace.

faq.q: Who was Raleigh when he was alive?
faq.answer: In life, Raleigh was a mortal resident of the kingdom of Lordaeron. He was married to a woman named Deliah and shared a friendship with a man named Valdred Moray before the Scourge swept through the realm.

faq.q: Why does Raleigh want revenge on Valdred Moray?
faq.answer: Raleigh seeks revenge against someone from his former life. The wedding ring brought to him leads into the details of that grievance.

faq.q: How did Raleigh become free from the Scourge?
faq.answer: Raleigh was slain and raised into servitude by the Scourge during the Third War. When the Lich King's control slipped following attacks on the Frozen Throne, Sylvanas Windrunner led an uprising, freeing Raleigh and many others to form the Forsaken.

angles.text: Raleigh's treatment of his former human ties offers a disturbing example of one Forsaken's response to undeath.
